name: date-field-day-picker
title: Date field (Day Picker + popover)
description: Masked text input plus a Base UI popover calendar powered by react-day-picker. Typing and picking stay in sync.
docs: Install: npx shadcn@latest add flixlix/ictus/date-field-day-picker. Import react-day-picker/style.css once in your app if the calendar looks unstyled.
